calculation.description: Ranks instruments by negative trailing 30-session daily return volatility; higher values mean lower volatility. Signal is lagged one session before cross-sectional use. The observed negative IC indicates the inverse (higher volatility) was rewarded in this sample.

validation.regime_notes: Negative aggregate IC and ICIR pass absolute benchmark gates; negative IC persists in 2020-22 and 2031 YTD, while 2023-30 is weaker. Treat as a contrarian/high-volatility exposure and use conservatively pending library correlation audit.
